versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the patent-layout-analysis skill for generating comprehensive project initiation reports in specified technical/product fields.
- Supports simultaneous retrieval and analysis of both domestic and international patent data, including mandatory checks on leading industry players (user-extendable).
- Provides market size and trend research, technology hotspot identification, whitespace detection, global applicant jurisdiction heatmaps/trends, competitive landscape, opportunity/risk assessments, and differentiated project recommendations.
- Outputs a modular, visually optimized, standalone HTML report (with left navigation, data visualizations, and standardized sections).
- Ensures full traceability, completeness of key entities, and strict adherence to quality assurance rules.
- Requires proper MCP (Zhihuiya platform) configuration for full data retrieval functionality.
